question: Who is the author of the epic poem 'Padmavat'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Malik Muhammad Jayasi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Malik Muhammad Jayasi** is the author of the **epic poem 'Padmavat'.**
 
• The poem narrates the story of** Rani Padmini**, the **queen of Chittorgarh**, and the** siege of the fort by Alauddin Khilji **in the **14th century.**
 
• The poem has been a** subject of controversy** and debate due to its** portrayal of historical events** and characters.
 
• The poem has been translated into **various languages** and has been adapted into** films and plays.**
 
• Malik Muhammad Jayasi was a **Sufi poet** who lived in the **16th century **in the Indian subcontinent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuldeep Nayyar** was a renowned **Indian journalist and author,** known for his **political commentary and social activism.** 

 
 
• He has **not** authored the epic poem 'Padmavat'.
 
 
 
• **Kalidasa** was a classical **Sanskrit poet and playwrigh**t who lived in ancient India. 
 
 
• He is known for his works such as **'Abhijnanasakuntalam' and 'Meghadutam'.**
 
• He has **not **authored the epic poem 'Padmavat'.
 
 
 
• **Al-Biruni **was a **Persian scholar** who lived in the **11th century**. 
 
 
• He is known for his contributions to the fields of **mathematics, astronomy, and geography**. 
 
• He has **not** authored the epic poem 'Padmavat'.
